newsitem.title: USA: COREstaff to buy On-line Resources.
newsitem.headline: COREstaff to buy On-line Resources.

text.p: COREStaff Inc said Monday it has agreed to buy all of the issued and outstanding stock of On-Line Resources Inc for an undisclosed amount in an all cash transaction. Closing is expected September 18.
On-Line is an information technology company headquartered in Orlando, Fla., and had revenues in excess of $22 million for the 12 months ended July 31.

With the addition of On-Line, COREStaff's information technology group, which operates as COMSYS Information Technology Services, will have pro forma 1996 revenues of approximately $240 million, the company said.
COREStaff is a national provider of temporary and contract staffing with two operating units, COREStaff Staffing Services and COMSYS Information Technology Services.

The purchase of On-line Resources will help COREstaff's international recruiting operatins in the United Kingdom, the company said. It added that On-line Resources co-founder N.C. Murthy will assist the company in "evaluating and potentially participating in investments in India."
